claude_proposed_widenings.name: auto_move_area_attachment
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The wall moves 50 feet away from the caster at the start of each caster turn, autonomously and directionally. reposition_attachment requires a caster-spent action; this movement is triggered by the passage of the caster's turn with no action cost and a fixed direction. No v4 atom covers area attachments that translate themselves each turn.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: at the start of each of your turns after the wall appears, the wall, along with any creatures in it, moves 50 feet away from you

claude_proposed_widenings.name: LevelAxis.round
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's per-turn damage decreases by 1d10 each round from 5d10 down to 0. This is a linear decay indexed by rounds elapsed within the duration. The current LevelAxis union (character | class | slot | subclass | proficiency_bonus) has no 'round' variant, making it impossible to express per-round decreasing or increasing dice amounts.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the damage the wall deals on later rounds is reduced by 1d10

claude_proposed_widenings.name: TargetSizeFilter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ongoing save_gate applies only to 'Huge or smaller' creatures. TargetTypeFilter narrows by creature type (humanoid, beast, etc.); no parallel filter exists for creature size. A TargetSizeFilter with a threshold ('huge_or_smaller', 'large_or_smaller', etc.) is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Any Huge or smaller creature inside the wall or whose space the wall enters when it moves must succeed on a Strength saving throw

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.on_creature_attempts_move
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Creatures caught in the wall must succeed on a Strength (Athletics) check vs spell save DC to move at all; failure means no movement. The existing on_creature_moves trigger fires after movement occurs, not as a gate before it. An ability_check_gate on 'creature attempts to move' is a distinct trigger shape needed to model conditional movement restraint.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the creature must succeed on a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC to move at all. If it fails the check, it can't move

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingDamageCapPerRound
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell specifies a creature can take the moving-wall damage only once per round, even if the wall passes through its space multiple times. There is no 'max once per round per creature' cap mechanism on ongoing save_gate operations.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature can take this damage only once per round

claude_proposed_widenings.name: AreaShapeDescriptor.rect_cuboid
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The wall is 300 ft long × 300 ft high × 50 ft thick — a rectangular cuboid. The current area shapes (sphere, cone, cube, cylinder, emanation, line) cannot represent this. A cube requires equal sides; a line has length and width but no height axis.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can make the wall up to 300 feet long, 300 feet high, and 50 feet thick

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.area_dimension_reaches_zero
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell ends when the wall's height reaches 0 feet — an autonomous self-termination condition based on the area's own geometry decrementing each turn, not a target action. The current DurationEndTrigger vocabulary covers target actions (attacks, casts, takes damage, dons armor) but has no 'tracked dimension reaches threshold' trigger.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When the wall reaches 0 feet in height, the spell ends
